title: Letter to Edward Partridge and Others, 10 December 1833
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Mills, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Edward Partridge, William W. Phelps, John Whitmer, Sidney Gilbert, John Corrill, Isaac Morley, and others, Liberty, Clay Co., MO, 10 Dec. 1833.
